method_review.total_weight_slab: Correct: reciprocal squaring reverses the positive target-error interval; intersect with summed lower/upper weight endpoints. Closed singleton intersections remain feasible; only lower>upper is empty.
method_review.fixed_sum_extrema: Correct exchange argument: fill capacities from smallest lower-modulus endpoint for minimum and largest upper-modulus endpoint for maximum.
method_review.weight_sum_optimization: Correct: each capacity segment numerator is affine in S and mean is beta+alpha/S. Positivity makes it monotone or constant; slab endpoints and in-slab capacity breakpoints suffice. Ties and zero capacities do not change values.
method_review.exact_projection: Correct: the nonempty weight box/slab is compact convex; its product with modulus boxes is connected, and positive-denominator mean is continuous. Its image is the entire closed interval between extrema. Subtracting this image from the independent target interval gives the exact subset delta interval.
method_review.mask_and_group_operations: Correct under the conditional model: union all fixed-cardinality subset intervals without filling gaps, then intersect across groups and any external necessary bound.
method_review.prior_bound_limit: The existing 22599-group interval B contains necessary marginal information only. Nonempty intersection with B would not establish simultaneous feasibility for those earlier groups. Candidate states this limit.
method_review.rounding_and_representation: Exact rational endpoint/weight arithmetic is sufficient; use outward decimals only for display. Exactness is for the closed independent-box model, not producer rounding ancestry or a calibrated uncertainty law.
method_review.complexity: The fixed-subset sort/segment method does not remove combinatorial subset growth. No complete enumeration is needed or admitted here.
